privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: RexFoot privacy policy: data collected, cookies, and your rights.
privacy.introBody: This privacy policy describes how RexFoot (rexfoot.com) handles data when you browse the site and, where applicable, use the RexFoot Android app.
privacy.dataBody:
Browsing without an account: no personal data is collected. An anonymous technical identifier (cookie) may be set to count page views for statistical purposes, with no link to your identity.
Creating an account (optional): email address, password (stored encrypted, never in plain text), display name and, if you choose, a profile picture. This information is used to sign you in, manage your favorites and, if enabled, display a public profile.
Audience measurement: RexFoot may use an analytics tool (e.g. Google Analytics) to understand overall site usage through aggregated, anonymous statistics.
privacy.useBody: The data collected is used solely to operate the site and app (sign-in, favorites, profile display), improve the service, and keep it secure (limiting abuse, preventing fraud).
privacy.sharingBody:
RexFoot does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for any purpose.
Your data is only shared with the technical providers strictly necessary to operate the site (hosting, database), who access it only to perform the requested services and are bound by confidentiality.
privacy.cookiesBody: RexFoot does not use advertising cookies. A technical cookie may be used to keep you signed in if you have an account, remember your preferences (such as language), or anonymously count page views.
privacy.rightsBody: You may at any time request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, as well as deletion of your account, by writing to the address below. Requests are handled within a reasonable timeframe, in accordance with applicable data protection law.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about this privacy policy or your personal data, you can contact RexFoot at: footrexofficial@gmail.com.

The RexFoot website is hosted and operated with the assistance of professional technical providers.
Information relating to hosting, the domain name, and the technical and network infrastructure may be disclosed to the competent authorities as part of a legally justified request, in accordance with applicable regulations.
legal.ipBody:
All elements making up the RexFoot website, including its structure, visual identity, graphic design, logo, text and graphic elements, are protected under applicable intellectual property provisions, unless otherwise stated.
Unless prior express authorization is granted, any reproduction, representation, modification, adaptation, distribution or exploitation, in whole or in part, of content belonging to RexFoot is prohibited.
Articles and editorial content published on the site are produced by the RexFoot editorial team, unless otherwise indicated.
Photographs, videos, illustrations and other visual content remain the property of their respective authors, producers or rights holders. Their presence on RexFoot is for editorial and informational purposes, with source or credit indicated where known and available.
If you hold rights to content published on RexFoot and wish to report a use you consider unauthorized, you may contact the editorial team at: footrexofficial@gmail.com.
legal.dataBody:
When creating an account on RexFoot, certain information may be requested, including an email address and a display name.
RexFoot commits to never selling users' personal data or sharing it with third parties for advertising purposes.
The site does not use cookies for advertising tracking. A technical cookie may be used to remember certain user preferences, such as the selected language.
Users may request the deletion of their account and associated data from their "My account" area, where this feature is available, or by sending a request to: footrexofficial@gmail.com.
Any request will be processed in accordance with applicable personal data protection regulations.
legal.responsibilityBody:
RexFoot strives to provide reliable, up-to-date and verified information. However, despite the precautions taken in writing and publishing content, no guarantee can be given as to the completeness, accuracy or ongoing timeliness of all information published.
RexFoot cannot be held liable for any errors, omissions or consequences resulting from the use of the information available on the site.
legal.contactBody: For any question regarding the site, its content, copyright or personal data, you may contact RexFoot at: footrexofficial@gmail.com.
